content: Hen nangurahan Jesus hen he-en hen anchichay ifana.

Angkay hiyachi way mafigat wat lagsak way Manmanma-an hen iggay mapchitan hen a-anà hen ganà Israel ad Egipto, yag innilan Jesus way inumchah hen tempon hen mamfangchana ad uchu an Amana. Yag ammag amchan hen layadna hen anchichay tatagu way sommorot an hiya hen antoy lota way ammag maid mepaniyan hen manlaychana an chicha, yag empàipàilana hen yachiy layadna ingganah natéyana.
Angkay hiyachi way cha mangan cha Jesus ya hen anchichay pasorotna, loohat ena-awis Chumunyu hen hamhamà Judas Iscariote way anà Simon way mangenlao an Jesus.
Ah Jesus, a-ammuna way emporang Amana hen aminay egad an hiya, yag a-ammuna agé way ah Apudyus hen narpowana ya hiya agé chillu hen mamfangchana.
Yachi way chacha mangan, yag tommàchég ah Jesus yag kena-anna hen anchi agwan hen lumfongna yag annaat elepat hen towarya hen awàna.
Yag tenarwana hen parangga ah chanum yag annaat ilugi way mangurah hen he-en hen anchichay pasorotna way chana eponah hen anchi towarya way enleleppatna ah awàna.
Angkay hiyachi way empachahna an Simon Pedro, ekat Pedrowén, “Apo, ay ammoh heaat agé hen mangurah hen he-è.”
Yag ekat Jesusén, “Achim tot-owa ma-awatan ad uwan hen antoy chà ammaan, ngém ma-awatam chillu ah awni.”
Yag ekat agé chillu Pedrowén, “Achi angkay poros mafalin way hea hen mangurah hen he-è.” Yag anat ekat Jesusén, “No achì urahan hen he-em, achi mafalin way mampasorot-o hea.”
“Wat no yaha peet Apo,” way ekat Pedro, “faén yanggay hen he-è hen uraham ta uray agé hen limà ya hen urù.”

Ngém ekat Jesusén, “Hen anchi looh nan-améh, nachachallosan met, wat achi masapor kasen maurahan amin hen acharna te manongad yanggay hen he-ena. Yag chàyu, nau-ullahan-ayu amin, ngém wacha chillu hen anchi iha an chàyu way cha-an.”
Hen anchi nangaryan Jesusén wacha chillu hen iha way cha-an maurahan, enalenachi te a-ammuna way wacha hen mangenlao an hiya.
Angkay hiyachi way narpas hen nangurahan Jesus hen he-echa, kasenna inigga hen anchi lumfongna yag i tummùchu, yag ekatna way mangaliyén, “Ay na-awatanyu hen anchi an-owat enammaan an chàyu.
Hamham-ényu ngén, te chayu ekatén haén hen mistoroyu ya Apoyu, yag usto met hen annay chayu aryén te tot-owa.
Wat haén way Apoyu ya mistoroyu, no haén hen mangurah hen he-eyu, masapor koma man-innurah-ayu agé ah he-e.
An-og enammaanchi ta wachay torachényu ta hen anchi enammaà an chàyu, yachi agé koma hen ammaanyu hen tapena.
Te tot-owa hen antoy ifagà an chàyu way maid alepan ah nangatngato no hen apona, ya maid agé fafà-arén ah nangatngato no hen anchi cha mamabfaar an hiya.
Wat gapo ta ma-awatanyu hen anchi laychê way aryén, wat an-ayug lomaylayad no ammaanyu.”

Entoroy Jesus way mangaliyén, “Achì aryén chaha an chàyu amin, te innilà chillu hen kenatataguyu way penepelè, ya innilà agé way wacha hen iha way achi metape hen antoy chà aryén. Ngém masapor chillu tomot-owa hen anchi nesosorat way alen Apudyus way ekatnéén, ‘Hen anchi iha way cha mèamèan an haén, hiyaat agé hen anchi mangempapchit an haén.’
Ifagàto an chàyu ad uwan ta anat umchah, ta no umchah, yaha hen manot-owaanyu way haén tot-owa hen anchi empopostan Apudyus way umale.
Ya tot-owa hen antoy ifagà an chàyu way heno way tagu way mangimfilang hen anchichay hénagê, chana agé ifilang haén. Yag no ifilangna agé haén, chana agé ifilang hen anchi nannag an haén.”
Hen nangimfag-an Jesus no heno hen mangenlao an hiya

Angkay hiyachi way enalen Jesus amin chachi, ammag lommaweng way térén hen hamhamàna yag annaat elawag way mangaliyén, “Tot-owa hen antoy ifagà way wachan iha an chàyu way mangentochar an haén ah matéyà.”
Yachi yag anchaat man-aheinnila amin hen anchichay pasorotna te maid innilacha no henoh nadchi paat hen chana aryén.
Yag yachi, wachan ihay pasorot Jesus way laylaychéna way haénchi way Juan, yag nichachapatà an hiya way tummutùchu.
Wat sininyaran Pedro haén ta hanhanà ano an Jesus no henoh nadchi paat hen anchi chana aryén.
Wat nànàéyà way nehachag paat an Jesus yag an-owat imohon way mangaliyén, “Apo, heno paat ah nadchi hen cham aryén.”
Yag ekat Jesusén, “Hen anchi tagu way mangidchatà hen antoy tenapay way esabfang-o wat hiyachi.” Yachi yag ensabfangna hen anchi tenapay yag inidchatna an Judas way anà Simon Iscariote.
Yag yachi way innaran Judas hen anchi tenapay, yag ammag nihurugat ah Chumunyu an hiya. Yag anat ekat Jesusén, “In-a ta ammaamat hen annay cham hamham-én.”
Ngém chàniyanchi way cha mèan an hiya, iggayni ma-awatan no pakay yachin enalen Jesus an Judas.

Yag gapo ta ah Judas hen nanangchén hen pelak, ekat hen tapenéén an ménat cha hénagén Jesus hiya way i lomaoh masaporni hen hiyachiy lagsak, no achi an i umidchat ah pelak hen anchichay maid mafalinna.
Angkay hiyachi way enawat Judas hen anchi tenapay, lommayawat. Yag lafi hen na-ammaan amin cha nadchi.
Hen anchi kà-amma way orchin Jesus hen tatagu

Angkay hiyachi way lommayaw ah Judas, imfagan Jesus an chàni way tapena way mangaliyén, “Haén way Pangorowan hen Tatagu, inumchah ad uwan hen tempon hen kachayawà. Yag gapoh machayawà, machayaw agé ah Apudyus.
Wat no haén hen mangempàila hen kachayawan Apudyus, wat epàilan Apudyus agé hen kachayawà way Pangorowan hen Tatagu yag ad uwan hen ka-ammaana.

Chàyu way kaman a-anào, an hen-aketan yanggay hen mì-iggawà an chàyu yag no ah awni, anapénà an chàyu. Wat hen imfagà hen anchichay ponò hen Judio, hiya agé hen ifagà an chàyu way achiayu maka-ale hen ayà.

Wat ad uwan, wacha hen kà-amma way orchin way iyurchin-o an chàyu way hen hiyachiy orchin, masapor man-ahelennayad-ayu ta kaman hen enkaman-o way manlayad an chàyu, yachi agé hen ekamanyu way man-ahelennayad.
Te no man-ahelennayad-ayu, elasin amin hen tatagu way chàyu hen pasorot-o.”
Hen nangimfag-an Jesus hen menhootan Pedro an hiya
Yachi yag nan-ale ah Simon Pedro way mangaliyén, “Oo Apo, ngém chuud peet hen ayam nò.” Yag ekat Jesusén, “Achiayu maka-ale hen anchi ayà ad uwan ngém umunud-ayu chillu ah tapen chi ag-agaw.”
Yag chaat chillu ekat Pedrowén, “Apo, pakay achiyà makaunud an hea ad uwan, te nakasaganaà met way metnod an hea uray yachin iyatéy-o.”
Yachi yag anat ekat Jesusén, “Ay tot-owa way nansasaggana-a way mìyatéy an haén. Te tot-owa hen antoy ifagà an hea, Pedro, way achi manollaò hen manò ah awni yag penetlomat way mangenhoot an haén.”
